# RC59 — Close Other Buffers

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/wscrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc K` / `core.close-other-buffers` / `Close Other Buffers`.
- Added `:close-others`, `:close-other-buffers`, and `:only`.
- The action keeps the active buffer and closes every other clean buffer.
- If any other buffer has unsaved changes, the operation refuses visibly and closes nothing.
- Closed buffers are removed from workspace indexing and recovery bookkeeping.
- Updated README and the real-iPad QA matrix to cover the clean close path, dirty-neighbor refusal, and command-line route.
